idea-plugin.name: Nebula Violet Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A violet theme family in three brightness levels: Light (lavender chrome, white editor), the original deep-purple Nebula Violet, and Midnight (near-black, for low light and OLED screens).

Each level comes in a standard palette and a Colorblind palette. The colorblind-safe syntax, diff, file-status and console colors stay distinguishable with protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia: every pair is checked in a simulation of each condition, and all text meets WCAG AA contrast.

Every theme also has an Islands version for the Islands UI (2025.3+), with rounded tool windows and editor islands on a separate frame.

Choose one under Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance | Theme. Each comes with its matching editor color scheme.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0

  • New Light and Midnight themes alongside the original dark Nebula Violet.
  • New Colorblind palette for all three brightness levels. Its syntax, diff, file-status and console colors stay distinguishable with protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia.
  • Every theme comes in a classic and an Islands version (12 themes in total), each with a matching editor color scheme.
  • The new themes meet WCAG AA contrast for text, including default buttons and inlay hints.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with two variants: Nebula Violet (classic) and Nebula Violet Islands (Islands UI, 2025.3+).
  • Matching Nebula Violet editor color scheme.
